title: План реализации сайта «Умный квадрат» (первый релиз)
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan for the Astro static site: scaffolding, tokens, pages, JSON data, CGI form, and Beget deploy.
notes: Executable plan (goal, architecture, tech stack, task checkboxes with commands and test hooks). Not an ADR (no status/decision) and not a PRD (no user stories). Fits SPEC as an implementation contract with technical constraints; ambiguity recorded because generic 'plan' is outside the five-type taxonomy.
